description: This file is a PHP script for the vtiger CRM system, responsible for displaying a scheduled report email configuration page. It initializes dependencies, retrieves report schedule information, assigns various scheduling and recipient data to the Smarty template engine, and renders the SMTP email scheduling template.

classes.name: VTScheduledReport
classes.description: A class that manages scheduled report configurations, including retrieving schedule info and recipient HTML content.

methods.name: getReportScheduleInfo
methods.description: Loads scheduling details for a specific report.

methods.name: getSelectedRecipientsHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML content for the selected report recipients.

methods.name: isScheduled
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the report is scheduled.

methods.name: scheduledFormat
methods.description: The format in which the report is scheduled.

methods.name: scheduledInterval
methods.description: An array containing scheduling interval details: type, time, date, day, month.
